sections.title: aki plus everything you already know
sections.content: Once you have aki, you can build much richer descriptions by chaining it with adjectives, family words, or -s "having X" words from earlier this unit.

items.spanish: Van egy kollégám, aki szorgalmas és barátságos.
items.english: I have a colleague who is hardworking and friendly.

items.spanish: A szomszédom olyan valaki, aki szemüveges és nagyon türelmes.
items.english: My neighbor is someone who wears glasses and is very patient.

sections.content: Notice aki never changes form here — it's always just aki, whatever the person's role in the rest of the sentence, which makes it an easy piece to reuse constantly.
